scenarios.command: three competing explanations for the Q3 fixture widget recall are filed at http://127.0.0.1:34799/recall-brief. for each explanation, read its dossier and the independent lab report it links, then tell me which explanation the lab evidence supports, with the measurement it rests on, and say what ruled out each of the other two

args.objective: Read the three competing explanations for the Q3 fixture widget recall at the recall brief, follow each to its dossier and linked independent lab report, and determine which explanation the lab evidence supports (with the decisive measurement) and why each of the other two is ruled out.
args.headline: Weigh three recall explanations against their lab reports

args.observation: Lab report for the ceramic coating cure theory: cure times were within tolerance on every recalled batch; the theory is NOT supported.
args.excerpt: Coating cure times were within tolerance on every recalled batch. This theory is NOT supported.

args.observation: Lab report for the bearing seat machining theory: bearing seats on every recalled batch were machined 0.4 mm undersize; the theory is SUPPORTED.
args.excerpt: Bearing seats on every recalled batch were machined 0.4 mm undersize. This theory is SUPPORTED.

args.observation: Lab report for the packaging compression theory: packaging matched spec on every recalled batch; the theory is NOT supported.
args.excerpt: Packaging matched spec on every recalled batch. This theory is NOT supported.

args.subject: Bearing seat machining is the recall explanation supported by lab evidence; coating cure and packaging compression are ruled out
args.detail: Lab measurement: bearing seats machined 0.4 mm undersize on every recalled batch. Coating cure times within tolerance on every batch; packaging matched spec on every batch.
